value: Binary name `rvr` locked 2026-05-06; rejected alternatives recorded so future audits don't redo the work. REJECTED: `rev` (util-linux collision — blocks every Linux install), `re` (overloaded), `rv` (npm taken + active Homebrew Ruby version manager). `rvr` is Homebrew-clean; bare npm name taken by an abandoned FAA aviation tool, sidestepped via scoped @seabear/reverie with bin "rvr" (standard gh/pnpm pattern). Accepted tradeoff: `npx rvr` won't work, `npx @seabear/reverie` does — npm is the tertiary install path behind GitHub binaries + Homebrew. FALLBACK if rvr becomes contested: `revr`.
